scientific_integrity: The minimum-rank theorem has a complete symbolic proof and an independently implemented finite subset-search comparison; the latter is corroboration, not proof for all sizes. No independent audit or publication claim is made.
scientific_limitations: No shortest minimum-rank word length formula is asserted.
The unit-jump case and singleton-active-set synchronization are special cases with prior antecedents.
A covering formulation in unindexed literature remains a residual originality risk.
title: Jump-and-symmetry formula for minimum rank in cyclic partial-translation automata
